messages:
matt: Need JIT elevation for service account `ingest-worker@redwood-prod` to impersonate and pull raw request logs for a PII investigation. Short window (~30m). Anyone available to approve? Ticket #12345. Plan: run impersonation via gcloud, query BigQuery dataset `prod_ingest.raw_events`. Concern: some free-text fields may contain PII; want to pull blobs into a secure workspace to triage, not export to S3.

security-bot: Please follow JIT access flow: submit /breakglass request at https://redwood.internal/breakglass and include justification. Approval required from eng-security. Audit entries auto-created.

liz: @matt quick q — are you pulling from Cloud Logging or BigQuery? Also what's the exact set of queries and time window? We need a short justification and proposed start/end times.

matt: BigQuery (`prod_ingest.raw_events`). Proposed window: 2026-03-18T15:30Z -> 2026-03-18T16:00Z (30m). Queries: sample below. Goal: identify PII in `event_payload` free-text fields for a small user cohort. Not exporting off platform, will keep in secured project folder.

matt: ```sql
-- sample query
SELECT event_id, user_id, event_payload
FROM `redwood-prod.prod_ingest.raw_events`
WHERE _PARTITIONTIME BETWEEN TIMESTAMP('2026-03-17') AND TIMESTAMP('2026-03-18')
AND event_type = 'ingest'
LIMIT 1000;
```

adam: I can buddy-review and join the session. If approved I can be on standby to revoke access quickly.

sam: For redaction, consider masking emails with regexp_replace: `REGEXP_REPLACE(event_payload, r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")`. Also prefer running queries in ephemeral VM with no external egress.

liz: OK — we can approve 1hr impersonation for `ingest-worker@redwood-prod` limited to BigQuery read and 'iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken' for impersonation. Conditions: (1) run from bastion `sec-audit-01` or ephemeral VM in `sec-project`, (2) session capture enabled, (3) no exports to external buckets, (4) include exact query list in the breakglass form. Please update the ticket with the command you'll run.

matt: Thanks. I'll update ticket and request start at 2026-03-18T15:30Z. Command I'll use: `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=ingest-worker@redwood-prod` then `bq` CLI. Will run from sec-audit-01.

liz: Approved conditionally — please ping in this thread when session starts and paste the breakglass ID. :white_check_mark: 

matt: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
